column3: “Had relations” makes explicit the idiom of drawing near.
“By the king” stands for “before the king.”
“Spreading streams” replaces the image of spreading wings.
“Huddle together” gives a gathering sense to the opening command.
“Instead” and “why consult” supply the connection and question.
“They” is plural where the final Hebrew pronoun is singular.
The upward look is placed before cursing; the Hebrew places it afterward.
